title: The Pistol Shrimp
description: Snapping shrimp, also called pistol shrimp, have one enlarged claw. When it snaps shut it emits an enormously powerful wave of bubbles capable of stunning larger fish and breaking small glass jars. Colonies of snapping shrimp make so much sound that they can interfere with sonar. Source: Wikipedia, Alpheidae.
pinned_comment: Some species have a hood over their eyes that experiments suggest dampens the shockwaves from other shrimp. Did you know sea animals could be this loud? 🦐 Tell me below 👇
